verdict.rationale: Crossmint's stablecoin-wallet quickstart runs on Base Sepolia, a testnet, which suggests wallet flows can be tested without production funds. Its own Agent Checkouts docs, however, say testing is production-only because "there is no staging environment for it." Missing for 10: a documented Crossmint staging/sandbox environment or test API keys, sandbox coverage for agent cards and agent checkouts, explicit isolation from production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Create a user-owned smart wallet, authorize an agent as a delegated signer, and send USDXM on Base Sepolia.
there is no staging environment for it
